tb21_profile.skill: Write a reversible pair of scripts that walk a directory tree, repack/split its contents to satisfy per-directory count and per-file byte-size caps, and reconstruct the original structure and bytes exactly; plus set up a uv/pyproject.toml environment
tb21_profile.domain: Python filesystem manipulation (os.walk, chunking by size, tar/zip-style repackaging, manifests), reproducible dependency management with uv and pyproject.toml
tb21_profile.task_form: implement-from-spec: build two CLI scripts (forward transform + exact inverse) validated by byte-for-byte round-trip on a data slice

searches: tools.py search all "uv sync|uv venv|uv run|pyproject.toml" -n 25
tools.py search tmax "reconstruct the original|revert.*back|losslessly|round.trip|repack|reassemble|reversible|byte-for-byte identical|exactly the original" -n 25

notes: TMax carries this task strongly: my own searches for chunk/repack/reconstruct/byte-for-byte surfaced task_002475, task_002193, task_003344, task_002545, task_002832 - several stronger than the lexical shortlist, which was dominated by generic 'data pipeline / ETL / dataset' overlap on the word 'data'. The single best structural match is task_002193 (two scripts: dir->archive->dir, byte-for-byte round-trip, size budget). The task has two sub-skills: (a) size/count-bounded reversible chunking, best served by TMax and borgbackup; (b) reproducible uv/pyproject.toml dependency setup, which only the RTS poetry/pyproject-reconcile tasks touch - no corpus has a genuine uv task ('uv sync/venv/run' returned nothing). SWE-Smith/Rebench lose on task_form as expected; borg and dask-rechunk are the only two with true chunking domain. All corpora yielded 10 defensible candidates, though TW ranks 8-10 and several SWE entries are overall<=2. Merge note: the RTS find_pdf.py / compute_gcd CLI-arg-refactor family recurs and is near-duplicated; count it as one weak signal.
